# Phonely Documentation

Use this file as the compact entrypoint for Phonely's public documentation.

## Canonical public pages
- Introduction: /get-started/introduction.md
- Quick start: /get-started/quick-start.md
- Dashboard overview: /get-started/dashboard-overview.md
- Ask AI: /key-concepts/ask-ai.md
- Call history and analytics: /call-history-ai-analytics/call-history-ai-analytics.md
- Agent review: /agent-review.md
- Call events: /call-events.md
- Outbound campaigns: /outboundcalling/createaoutboundcallingcampaign.md
- Settings overview: /manage-account-and-organization-settings/manage-account-and-organization-settings.md
- A/B testing: /testing/ab-testing.md
- Frontend API intro: /api-reference/introduction.md
- Webhook intro: /webhook-reference/intro.md
- Post-call webhook: /webhook-reference/endpoint/postcall-webhook.md

## Hidden AI runbooks
- Route map: /ai/route-map.md
- Build agent: /ai/build-agent.md
- Manage knowledge base: /ai/manage-knowledge-base.md
- Edit workflows: /ai/edit-workflows.md

- Configure outbound campaigns: /ai/configure-outbound-campaigns.md
- Frontend API boundaries: /ai/frontend-api-boundaries.md

## Retrieval rules
- Start with the matching canonical public page.
- Use the matching hidden AI runbook when exact step-by-step execution details are needed.
- Use the API reference or webhook reference for request, response, and payload details.
- Treat `/testing/evaluation` as legacy unless the question is explicitly about legacy evaluation flows.
- Use `/llms-full.txt` only when the compact file is insufficient.
